content: Lifestyle modifications that may enhance the effectiveness of this medication include reducing alcohol consumption and quitting smoking. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to adhere to the prescribed schedule as directed by your doctor. Contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately for guidance on what to do if a dose is missed. Store this medication either in the refrigerator or at room temperature, ensuring it is protected from light. Do not freeze it. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of this medication by flushing it down the toilet or pouring it into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This medication is used to treat specific fertility issues in women. It provides follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH), which support healthy ovarian function to produce eggs. Before starting this medication, read the Patient Information Leaflet and Instructions for Use provided by your pharmacist. Consult your healthcare professional for detailed instructions on how to prepare and administer this medication. It is administered via injection under the skin, typically in the abdomen, as directed by your doctor. The dosage and duration of treatment depend on your medical condition, response to treatment, and any other medications you may be taking. Use the solution immediately after mixing the medication. Inspect the product for particles or discoloration before use; do not use it if either is present. Before injecting each dose, clean the injection site with rubbing alcohol. Rotate the injection site with each dose to minimize the risk of skin injury. To reduce bruising, avoid rubbing the injection site after administering the shot. Use this medication exactly as prescribed by your doctor to achieve the maximum benefit. To help you remember, administer it at the same time each day. Common side effects may include headache, mild stomach pain or bloating, redness or pain at the injection site, breast tenderness, or dizziness. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. This medication may cause a condition known as ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS), which can occur during or after treatment. Rarely, severe OHSS can lead to sudden fluid accumulation in the abdomen, chest, and heart area. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other products containing follicle-stimulating hormone or luteinizing hormone, or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. This medication may cause dizziness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness until you can do so safely. Limit alcoholic beverages. This treatment may increase the likelihood of multiple births. Discontinue use of this medication if you become pregnant, as it must not be used during pregnancy. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if someone exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (such as blood hormone levels like estradiol and vaginal ultrasounds) should be conducted. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
